experiment_data.hypothesis: Constrained decoding channels BCS-related errors into type substitutions, producing a strong BCS-accuracy correlation (ρ ≈ -0.7 to -0.9) on the same batch type sets where unconstrained decoding shows no significant correlation (ρ=-0.14). If confirmed on the same 25 batches, this establishes format dependency as a paired comparison rather than relying on cross-batch-set inference.
